description: Op-shaped job that gzips + archives old Dagster compute log files to S3/GCS/local, then optionally deletes them from primary storage. Frees primary storage without losing audit trail.

min_age_days.description: Archive files older than this many days.
min_age_days.label: Min Age Days

archive_target.description: Archive destination type: local \| s3 \| gcs
archive_target.label: Archive Target

archive_prefix.description: Key prefix inside the bucket (or subdir under archive_local_dir).
archive_prefix.label: Archive Prefix

delete_after_archive.description: If True, delete the primary log file after successful archive. Default False (safer).
delete_after_archive.label: Delete After Archive

dry_run.description: If True (default), log what WOULD be archived without touching files.
dry_run.label: Dry Run
